title: LabTether local agent status v1
description: Body of GET /agent/status on the agent's local API, as the Go agent sends it (internal/agentcore/local_status.go StatusResponse). codes.v1.json holds the rules between fields that a schema cannot say.

asset_id.description: The asset ID the agent reports as, from the running identity.

group_id.description: Omitted when the agent has no group.

device_fingerprint.description: Omitted when the agent has no device key.

device_key_algorithm.description: Omitted when the agent has no device key.

connected.description: True only for an authenticated Hub connection. A socket that waits for enrollment approval is false.

disconnected_at.description: When the agent first lost or failed its Hub connection. Omitted while connected, while enrollment waits for approval, and before any failure.

last_error.description: Fixed code. codes.v1.json lists which codes go with each connection_state.

last_error_reason.description: Fixed code for the last failed connect attempt.

enrollment_error.description: The Hub's own words for a refused enrollment, one line of printable text, at most 300 characters. Never sent while connected is true.

uptime.description: Go time.Duration text truncated to whole seconds, such as 45s, 3m2s or 2h14m33s. The Go type omits it when started_at is the zero time.

alerts.description: Alerts the Hub pushed, oldest first. Always present; [] when there are none.

agent_version.description: Build version text, such as v2.0.1, git:abcdef or dev.

local_bind_address.description: Address the local API listens on. Omitted when unset.

update_available.description: The Go agent always sends false.

latest_version.description: Declared by the Go type, never sent by the Go agent.

timestamp.description: Go time.Time JSON: RFC 3339 with 0 to 9 fraction digits, trailing zeros dropped, Z for UTC or a numeric offset.

metrics.description: The latest telemetry sample (internal/agentcore/types.go TelemetrySample). Before the first collection every number is 0.

temp_celsius.description: Omitted when the platform gives no temperature.

alert.description: One alert as the Hub sent it in alert.notify. The agent passes severity, state and the text through without checking them. A timestamp the agent cannot read becomes 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z.
